raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 (ingest 2026-01-17) was re-delivered at 05:00 with 668 rows instead of about 350, so roughly 318 transactions appear twice in raw_transactions under the same txn_id. silver_transactions keeps every row, which causes the duplicate keys and inflates the 2026-01-16 volume and the gold aggregates. The fix is to keep one row per txn_id, the latest ingest, before filtering on POSTED.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
